suite: Frontline scoped follow-up projection and versioned proposal
environment: Actual TypeScript helper, synthetic projection fixtures
limits: Display/command construction checks; server authorization and real browser state are separately exercised.

checks.label: Exact selectors are accepted without granting authority
Refuse missing organisation
Refuse duplicate person
Refuse duplicate organisation
Refuse unknown selector
Refuse empty selector
Refuse unbounded selector
Explicit null household is distinct from empty visits
Missing plan is unavailable, not empty
Missing selected member refuses projection
Mismatched household versions refuse projection
Only the selected person’s planned item content is returned
Source due date, overdue state, owner and open status survive unchanged
Closed referenced work remains closed
Valid empty planned list stays explicitly empty
Duplicate slots refuse ambiguous projection
Duplicate cover refuses ambiguous versions
Projection leaves the input untouched
Reschedule retains all covered person versions and the existing household version
Noneligible slot cannot form a command
Unknown slot cannot form a command
Unchanged time cannot form a command
Out of range and invalid dates refuse
Unknown window refuses without an invented timing policy
Verified selected record projection excludes unrelated data
A different record cannot satisfy the URL selector
A missing record never becomes an empty identity
Accepted result requires the same previous-slot link and a real replacement identifier
Visible cover count is not inferred to be the total when other covers are outside scope
One visible covered person can still be a partially visible shared visit
An all-visible slot has no outside-scope limitation
Missing outside-scope metadata is unavailable, not assumed to be zero
Invalid outside-scope metadata cannot fabricate a sharing claim
